statutes.title: Tax on Residents - Rates
statutes.breadcrumbs: D.C. Code > Title 47 > Chapter 18 > Subchapter VI > § 47-1806.03
text_en: Imposes graduated personal income tax rates from 4.0% to top rate 10.75% for taxable income exceeding $1,000,000 in the District of Columbia.
text_es: Impone tasas de impuesto sobre ingresos personales graduadas desde 4.0% hasta tasa máxima de 10.75% sobre ingresos superiores a $1,000,000 en el Distrito de Columbia.
